native_scope: Systemd unit instance review plus unmodified C09 ACK protocol; physical cleanup conditional on kernel/manager/IO response

stages.A: MR_RECOVERY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; C00..C10 plus64 then intentional close78
stages.B: new independent namespace after A; full qualification then F1/F4 if separately authorized

fault_model.normal: Trusted Root/kernel, stable instance IDs, systemd responds, bounded scheduler and IO returns
unknown: SPAWNING Root loss before child identity publication
all independent stop sources or kernel/systemd/IO unavailable
caller own exit after tail seal requires external audit
fault_model.pre_T0: No T0/counter is fabricated; failure may be UNKNOWN with preserved preflight/activation records
